'''Moer''' was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the [[Dalon system]],<ref name="Journal10" /> a part of the [[Hewett sector/Legends|Hewett sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Reproduction/Legends|birthplace]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Liadden]], who by the age of eighteen had become a [[free-trader]] and the partner of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[To'iir]].<ref name="Journal10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Moer was introduced in "[[A Free-Trader's Guide to the Planets]]," an article written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien|Timothy O'Brien]] and published in [[May]] [[1996]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|tenth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Journal10" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Dalon [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body Moer, in grid square M-7.<ref name="TEA" />
